description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Andiyaiya Puveneswaran as a member of the Northern Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Mullativu
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a vacancy in a Provincial Council due to the death of a member.
